newsitem.title: JAPAN: Tobishima rises on report of restructuring support.
newsitem.headline: Tobishima rises on report of restructuring support.

text.p: Shares of Tobishima Corp rose on Monday morning on the Tokyo Stock Exchange because of a newspaper report that creditors of the debt-ridden construction firm were likely to accept its restructuring programme.
Tobishima was 13 yen higher at 201 yen at midday.

The Sankei Shimbun daily said on Saturday that the creditor financial institutions would accept the restructuring plan that Tobishima drafted last October in order to resolve its financial difficulties.
Under the plan, its creditors would be asked to reduce their claims against Tobishima for debts owed by its group companies to 100 billion yen from about 740 billion yen.

Fuji Bank Ltd , the main creditor bank for Tobishima, said on Monday that many of Tobishima creditors had responded positively to its restructuring programme but they have not reached a formal agreement yet on whether or not to accept the plan.
A Fuji spokesman said that Fuji, which itself has expressed support for Tobishima's plan, was making strong efforts to gain their acceptance of the plan by the end of this month.
